<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Wulf" width="100%">

<p><strong>A local-first personal backlog for Windows.</strong></p>
<p>Capture first, organize second, act third.</p>

<a href="https://github.com/MathDevz/Wulf/releases/latest/download/Wulf-Setup-1.0.0.exe">
<p><span class="dlbtn">&#11015; Download for Windows &middot; 77 MB</span></p>
</a>

</div>

<hr>

<p>Most task apps make you file a thought properly before they'll accept it — pick a project, a priority, a date. So you don't write it down, and you lose it.</p>

<p>Wulf has one field. Type the thing, press Enter, it's captured. Sorting it out is a separate job you do later, if you feel like it.</p>

<p>Nothing is auto-scheduled, auto-prioritized or auto-sorted. Today only contains what you dragged there yourself. No AI, no account, no telemetry.</p>

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Queue">

<h2>The five sections</h2>

<table>
<tr><td><strong>Queue</strong></td><td>The pile. Everything lands here, in the order you decided.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Today</strong></td><td>Only what you deliberately dragged in.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Projects</strong></td><td>Tasks, subtasks, notes, files, deadlines, progress, history.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Later</strong></td><td>Kept, but out of the way.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Completed</strong></td><td>Searchable, restorable.</td></tr>
</table>

<h2>Capture syntax</h2>

<p>Type naturally. Every token is optional.</p>

<pre><code>
buy solder #electronics
finish the OLED driver !1 @tomorrow
design the enclosure ~3h
</code></pre>

<p><code>#tag</code> · <code>!1 !2 !3</code> priority · <code>~30m ~2h</code> estimate · <code>@today @later @tomorrow @weekend</code></p>

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Project">

<p>Progress is a plain count of what's done — <em>2 of 6 complete</em>. Subtasks roll into tasks, tasks roll into the project.</p>

<h2>Keyboard</h2>

<p><code>N</code> capture · <code>Ctrl K</code> search everything · <code>Ctrl 1–5</code> sections · <code>Space</code> complete · <code>Enter</code> details · <code>F2</code> rename · <code>T</code> <code>Q</code> <code>L</code> move · <code>Ctrl Z</code> undo · <code>Del</code> delete</p>

<p>Drag and drop works everywhere — reorder, move between sections, drop onto a project, drop files to attach.</p>

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Search">

<h2>Your data</h2>

<p>Everything lives in one readable file at <code>%APPDATA%\Wulf\data\wulf.json</code>.</p>

<p>Fully offline. Atomic writes with a rolling backup, versioned schema with migrations, automatic daily snapshots, and JSON export/import. Move the vault anywhere in Settings and Wulf follows it.</p>

<h2>Install</h2>

<p>Download, double-click, done. Windows will warn that the publisher is unknown because the installer isn't code-signed — click <strong>More info → Run anyway</strong>.</p>

<p>Uninstalling asks whether to keep or delete your data, and defaults to keeping it.</p>

<h2>Build from source</h2>

<pre><code>
npm install
npm run dist:win
</code></pre>
